children: Tropical Depression Six has formed southwest of the Azores, according to the US National Hurricane Center's latest advisory on Saturday.

This system is expected to generally move to the northeast for the next 24 to 36 hours, before turning toward the southwest in a couple of days, the NHC said, adding the system was about 525 miles (844.91 kilometer) southwest of the Azores, with maximum sustained winds of 35 miles per hour (55 km/h).
